summary: Executed backend pytest regression suite (11 tests) for auth, store isolation, finance math, validations, cross-user protection, and CSV import preview/commit-idempotency. Ran multiple Playwright UI passes for login, store switching, transactions, and payouts. Login is reproducibly successful; primary frontend blocker is marketplace selects showing blank in transaction/payout forms under real store switching scenarios.

critical.issue: No brute-force lockout observed: after 5 failed login attempts, valid credentials still immediately return 200.

minor.issue: CORS_ORIGINS is configured as '*' while allow_credentials=True; this is a risky/ambiguous auth CORS posture and should use explicit origins only.

ui_bugs.issue: Marketplace select intermittently renders empty (placeholder 'Pazar seçin') even when active store has marketplaces, leaving currency as '—' and blocking normal transaction entry.
Marketplace select can render blank for a CA-only store (expected CA preselection), preventing straightforward payout input flow.

integration_issues.issue: After store context changes, form Select components show controlled/uncontrolled warnings and can lose selected marketplace state.

action_items: Implement brute-force protection/rate-limit or temporary lockout on repeated failed logins.
Replace wildcard CORS with explicit trusted origins when credentials are enabled.
Fix transaction/payout marketplace preselection logic after store/marketplace context changes (remove controlled/uncontrolled transitions).
Retest full order-level UI grouping/edit/delete workflow after marketplace-select issue is fixed.
critical_code_review_comments: Auth hardening gap: no lockout path despite auth playbook requirement.
CORS config in backend/.env uses '*' with credentialed requests; tighten to explicit origins.
Select components in critical forms emit controlled/uncontrolled warnings; this correlates with blank selector state in UI.
seed_data_creation: Created temporary stores TEST_UI_USCA_* and TEST_CA_ONLY_UI during UI checks; both were deleted after testing.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression file is reusable and currently green (11/11). UI login works consistently with admin credentials. Focus next on reproducing and fixing marketplace select state loss in Transactions/Payouts after store context changes, then rerun full UI order-grouping/edit/delete and payout accounting scenarios.
rca of the issue: Likely root cause is state synchronization between StoreContext (activeMarketplace can be ALL) and form-local Select values. Forms initialize Select value from context/store but can transition through undefined/empty values while options update, producing uncontrolled<->controlled warnings and blank marketplace selection. Mitigation: keep Select values always controlled with explicit fallback (e.g., computed marketplace per store), and re-derive form marketplace whenever activeStore.marketplaces or activeMarketplace changes before rendering dependent currency/submit state.
